decisions.reason: Challenge version review: released(payer) <= deposited(payer) at every step matches the quoted intent that funds released for a payer must never exceed what that payer deposited. Approval is an interpretation for transaction checking only; it does not approve the contract or prove model/EVM equivalence.

Challenge version review: the balance-coverage reading (other payers deposits stay <= escrow balance at every step) is adopted as its own protection, distinct from the unrepresented registered-seller restriction which remains an open unresolved question for this contract. Approval is an interpretation for transaction checking only.

requirements.requirement: Released funds for a payer must never exceed that payer deposits.
requirements.intent_quote: funds released for a payer must never exceed what that payer deposited

requirements.requirement: Other payers' deposits must remain available in the escrow after any release.
requirements.intent_quote: other payers must keep their deposited funds available in the escrow at all times
